text:
anya: quick heads up — cert-rotator started failing decrypts in ap-south after I merged the keystore-role tighten PR last night. seeing AccessDenied from KMS. not a huge spike yet but failing renewal jobs across ~40 pods :grimacing:

mohit: can you paste the exact error log and the PR/commit id?

anya: pasted log below and PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/keystore/pull/412 (merged 2026-03-20 02:14 UTC)
```
[ERR] 2026-03-20T14:02:31Z cert-rotator cert-rotator/0 decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-rotator-sa is not allowed to use the key KeyId: arn:aws:kms:ap-south-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
    status code: 400, request id: 1111-2222
```

sec-bot: alert created: kms-decrypt-failure (severity: high) — 5912468031

devon: sounds like the keystore role lost kms:Decrypt on the regional CMK. PR tightened role to remove cross-account principals, right? if so key policy might also deny the role. check key policy + IAM allow.

anya: exactly. the PR removed the generic `service-keystore:*` binding and replaced with `keystore-rotator-sa` only. ap-south key policy still referenced the old AWS account principal mapping (we didn't propagate the new role arn to regional CMKs).

lia: short-term mitigation: can we revert the role change in the cluster or add a policy exception? We should avoid emergency wide-open keys. I propose: 1) add explicit kms:Decrypt allow for keystore-rotator-sa for ap-south CMK 2) patch cert-rotator to use fallback keystore for renewals 3) notify customers on SLA impact if >5m delay. Who can do 1 right now?

kelvin: I can update key policy in ap-south. sample patch we'll apply (needs kms:UpdateKeyPolicy):
```json
{
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowKeystoreRotatorDecrypt",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-rotator-sa"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

mohit: before kelvin updates, let's confirm the principal arn used by pods. run: `kubectl -n certs get deploy cert-rotator -o yaml | yq .spec.template.spec.serviceAccountName` and `kubectl -n certs exec -c cert-rotator <pod> -- printenv | grep -i role` — we had a migration that renamed the serviceAccount in eu-west. mismatch risk.

anya: running the checks now. serviceAccountName is `keystore-rotator-sa`. env ROLE_ARN is `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-rotator-sa` on affected pods.

infra-oncall: if kelvin patches key policy, also patch Audit config to emit the principal and request context for KMS denies — we need the full keyId/principal in logs for postmortem.

kelvin: applying minimal key policy allow to ap-south CMK now (will run as infra-ops). i will prune after we verify jobs recover. ETA 6m.

sec-bot: scheduled incident channel: #incident-kms-5912468031 created — join for war room.

devon: alternative if key policy change isn't allowed: set `CERT_ROTATOR_FALLBACK_STORE=true` in the cert-rotator deploy to use local (ephemeral) keystore until rotation completes. command: `kubectl -n certs set env deploy/cert-rotator CERT_ROTATOR_FALLBACK_STORE=true` — reduces security posture but limits SLA impact. only use for <1h.

anya: kelvin confirms patch applied. I see renewals succeeding again on 3 pods. logs: `Decrypt ok` and jobs completing.

lia: good. next steps: 1) kelvin to submit key policy change PR with audit trail + scope-limited principal and expiry 2) mohit to add e2e test in keystore CI that validates regional key policies for new RBAC mappings 3) devon to add a pre-merge check that compares serviceAccountName changes against key policies (or fail pipeline) 4) ops to run a postmortem and tag impacted customers if >5min SLA lapse

kelvin: filing key-policy PR now (https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-config/pull/879). it documents the emergency allow and a removal window.

mohit: I'll open a Keystore CI ticket and add a policy check job. also adding a note to the RBAC PR template: "ensure regional CMKs are updated or tooling will break rotators".

anya: thanks all. please ack on #incident-kms-5912468031 and add any additional mitigation notes. closing thread here once postmortem starts. :white_check_mark:
